Starting coins

Agreed target: 50–70 coins after card-granted equipment. Proposed allocation: the values below.

Starting coins = 40 + ancestry + culture + background + class.

Add these once after completing level 1. This is a starting purse, not income each level. It does not use DP or attributes. Resolve card equipment grants before shopping; there is no coin reimbursement for a duplicate or declined grant.

Contributions represent what the character brings on departure: savings, community support, prior work and preparation. They are not innate ancestry wealth, a moral ranking of cultures or a continuing class stipend. The largest ancestry difference is two coins. These allocations describe preparation, not biology.

Checks and examples

All 23,040 ancestry/culture/background/class combinations fall between 50 and 70 coins, before shopping. This enumerates coin contributions only; class attribute eligibility is still checked separately.

Minimum: Halfling + Forest Communities + Grove Tended + Odd = 40 + 0 + 5 + 5 + 0 = 50. Maximum: Elf + Learning Houses + Court Questioner + Intellect = 40 + 2 + 10 + 10 + 8 = 70.

At the low end, road essentials and a lesser potion cost 44 and leave 6. At the high end, the same basket leaves 26. The @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market} lists all prices; purchases still consume Bulk and obey hand/training requirements.

The @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.ecb931a056acc731.JournalEntryPage.002d7b4993294246]{six worked characters} now include purses and actual shopping ledgers. No one receives higher-level cards, extra DP or free potions.
